summary.en: Command-line tool for Lark (Feishu) APIs from ByteDance. The v1.0.100 release ships lark-cli-1.0.100-windows-arm64.zip.
summary.zh-TW: 字節跳動 Lark（飛書）的命令列工具，v1.0.100 版提供 lark-cli-1.0.100-windows-arm64.zip。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
